svg.aria-label: Five askers on the left, each labelled with its force: ISO/IEC 42001, a standard the company chose; the NIST AI RMF, a voluntary framework; a business customer's contract; the company's own AI policy; and Article 50(2) of the EU AI Act, a law. Four lines run to one record in the evidence pack, the assistant's evaluation report, which names its model, prompt and index versions and its result: 2 drafts wrong in 700, a bound of 0.90%. The fifth line ends at a written gap with an owner.
